Index of ▶Grande Ganadors

Mid-boss: Specially-rigged Vaisseau

Defeating "Pizzaro" unlocks:
Mary Read
Requerimiento (recipe is at Inspector until you defeat another Grande Ganador or until you craft it once; item for Sea Conquerors' Secret Treasure (No.2) Memorial Album)

Grande Title (speak to Spy after 1st victory)

Can drop the following:

Golden Arc (item for Sea Conquerors' Secret Treasure (No.2) Memorial Album)
Commander's Metal Paneling (Dark Blue)
The Moon (ship decoration)
Simple Sailor Equip. Repair Tools (unconfirmed for Maris)
Shipwright's Emergency Repair Tools (unconfirmed for Maris)
Armsmith's Simple Repair Tools (unconfirmed for Maris)
Shen Nung's Medicinal Herbs x5
Seal of condemnation
Seal of Valkyrie
Crystal Eye
Pegasus Feather
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools
Special Large 2-decked Hull
Custom Large 2 decked Row Boat
Legendary Craftsman's Carpentry Tools (amount varies)
Sailor's Journal of the Polar Sea (amount varies; from x1-4)
Patriot Award
Broken Cannon
Ripped Sails
Broken Armour
